start.title: Open on start
start.desc: The platform the WebUI opens to.

sort.title: Default sort
sort.desc: Default sort order when entering a platform.

type.title: Default type
type.desc: Default content type when entering a platform.

pageSize.title: Items per page
pageSize.desc: How many items to load at a time. More is slower and more likely to trigger platform rate limits.

dialog.title: Settings
dialog.hint: Settings are saved in this browser and don't sync to others.

density.title: Card density
density.desc: Compact fits more cards on screen; Cozy shows larger covers.

stats.title: Show engagement
stats.desc: Likes, comments and views on cards.

motion.title: Reduce motion
motion.desc: With “Always”, animations are kept to a minimum regardless of system settings.

adult.title: Show the adult section
adult.desc: Adds an Adult section to browse filters and bookmarks

experimental.note: These features are experimental. Their behavior and location may change.

rawJson.title: Show raw JSON
rawJson.desc: View the raw data returned by the platform in the detail view.

hoverPreview.title: Video preview on hover
hoverPreview.desc: Play a muted preview when hovering over a video card.

server.title: Server settings
server.hint: Saved in catbus on this machine; used by all browsers and the command line.
server.demo: Demo mode doesn't connect to catbus, so server settings can't be read or changed.
server.notJson: The server returned an unexpected response (HTTP {status})

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.desc: Proxy used to reach platforms. Supports http, https, socks5 and more; leave empty for no proxy.
proxy.platforms: Platform proxies (override the global proxy; read-only, change with {command})

comments.title: Comments to download
comments.desc: How many comments to fetch for each post
comments.risk: The more comments you fetch, the more requests are made, which can trigger the platform's rate limits or account verification.

replies.title: Replies to download
replies.desc: How many replies to fetch under each comment
